name: Bent-Knee Wall Calf Stretch
steps: Face a wall with your hands against it and step one foot behind you.
Bend your back knee and lean toward the wall with your back heel planted.
Hold the stretch low in the back calf, then ease upright.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Point your back toes straight toward the wall and keep your rear heel pressed flat.
Sink into the back knee gently until you feel the stretch low near the Achilles tendon.
